checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan escort captains: one available crew commander per fleet ship, role-based damage/evasion/upkeep bonuses, crew exclusion guards, and fleet-card/API/CLI controls.

impact_assessment.why: Crew could serve the flagship, outposts or away teams, but escorts had no officer slot and no named commander.
impact_assessment.benefits: Escorts gain a legible role-based commander, crew allocation gains a fourth destination, and fleet cards become more personal.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: legacy ships must default to no captain and crew payloads must stay backward compatible; dependency: captain bonuses touch damage, evasion and upkeep; concurrency: assignment mutates fleet state and the flight log under the engine lock; state: captains must persist and be blocked from away, outpost and duplicate commands.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add bonus, guard, persistence and API/CLI/UI regressions first; normalize missing captain role; verify the live assign and recall controls.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted captain_id/captain_role, role bonuses in damage/evasion/upkeep, crew exclusion and away/outpost/dismiss guards, /api/fleet/escort/captain, fleet captain|recall_captain CLI and fleet-card captain row implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-107 recorded; live Edge assigned Imani Vale to a corvette and recalled her; 937 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'escort-captains' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan quantum auto-freight: a docked policy that ships surplus cargo along the best net route every 6 ticks above a chosen minimum, with API, CLI and panel controls.

impact_assessment.why: Quantum freight required manually checking routes and pressing SHIP for every surplus commodity, while the local broker already automated market trades.
impact_assessment.benefits: Long-haul arbitrage can run unattended, surplus cargo stops idling in the hold, and manual SHIP controls remain available for exceptions.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: existing saves must default to an off policy and the normal order path must still charge fees, cargo and slots; dependency: automation calls the route report and place-order path; concurrency: tick-time orders mutate cargo, credits, policy and the flight log; state: cooldown, order count and last net must persist.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add policy, dock, best-route, cooldown, minimum and persistence regressions first; reuse place_quantum_order; verify the live toggle and auto order.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted QuantumAutomation, docked policy setup, best-route selection on a 6-tick cooldown through place_quantum_order, GET/POST automation endpoints, autotrade quantum CLI and AUTO-FREIGHT/MIN NET panel controls implemented with regressions.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-108 recorded; live Edge enabled auto-freight at min net 0 and shipped 10 titanium for a 1,569 cr net route; 945 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'quantum-automation' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan research pacts: standing-60 scientific agreements that persist per faction, add 5% passive research while at peace, and appear in the Empire tab and CLI.

impact_assessment.why: Trade pacts unlock at 40 and alliances at 70, leaving no mid-tier scientific agreement and no diplomatic acceleration for research.
impact_assessment.benefits: Standing 60 gains a distinct scientific reward, pacts reward peace, and the research queue benefits from faster passive intake.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: research_pacts must default empty for legacy saves and every clone must preserve it; dependency: the tick research gain now multiplies by active pacts; concurrency: diplomacy mutates standings, pacts and the flight log under the engine lock; state: war must suspend rather than delete a pact.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add standing, war, multiplier, report, persistence and UI/CLI regressions first; keep the multiplier additive and capped by pact count; verify the live R&D action.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted research_pacts, standing-60/war gates, +5% passive research multiplier, report/snapshot pact fields, R&D Empire action, CLI status/action and regressions implemented.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-109 recorded; live Edge formed a Sol Coalition research pact and showed +5% bonus; 953 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'research-pacts' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan codex milestones for trade and research pacts, escort captains, outpost specialization and repair, and quantum auto-freight, derived from existing persisted state.

impact_assessment.why: Recent diplomacy, command, outpost and automation systems shipped without codex goals, so players had no long-term milestone for them.
impact_assessment.benefits: Each recent system gains a visible progression goal, rewards stay paced with existing milestones, and legacy saves unlock retroactively.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: the codex report shape and metric labels must stay backward compatible; dependency: metrics read persisted pacts, captains, specializations, automation orders and stats; concurrency: repair_outpost now writes a stat under the engine lock; state: outposts_repaired needs legacy default zero and save round-trip coverage.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add metric, report and repair regressions first; derive six metrics from existing state; default the new stat to zero; verify the live codex tab and full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Added seven codex milestones and six reading metrics, incremented outposts_repaired on repair, and covered metrics, report completion and the repair stat with tests; 956 tests pass.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-110 documented; live Edge rendered all six checked milestones with no console errors; 956 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'codex-progression' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan escort captain progression: persist captain skill on the ship, scale role bonuses with it, and award captain XP in battles and drills.

impact_assessment.why: Captains provide a flat role bonus forever; their skill is invisible and never improves through combat, so the captain system has no progression after assignment.
impact_assessment.benefits: Captains grow into their roles, training and battles both matter, and the fleet card shows the skill behind its bonus.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: FleetShip gains a persisted captain_skill that must default safely; dependency: fleet damage, evasion and upkeep now read it; concurrency: battle victory rewrites crew, fleet ships and stats under the engine lock; state: promotions must sync the stored captain skill.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add legacy, assignment, scaling, training and victory regressions first; clamp skill 0-10; keep skill 0 neutral for old saves; verify the cockpit captain row and full gates.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Persisted captain_skill, added skill scaling for damage/evasion/upkeep, victory captain XP with promotion sync, drill sync, report/UI/CLI skill display and 6 regressions; 962 tests pass.
[3/3] README, COCKPIT and ADR-111 documented; live Edge showed S3 and the crew drill raised the fleet card to S4 with no console errors; 962 tests and 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'captain-progression' completed successfully.
